# aws-access-key negatives: no non-comment line holds a hit.
AWS's documented example: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
another example: ASIAFAKEFAKEEXAMPLE2
IAM user unique ID: AIDAFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKE
IAM role unique ID: AROAFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKE
too short: AKIAFAKEFAKEFAKEFAK
too long: AKIAFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEF
digit outside base32: AKIAFAKEFAKEFAKEFAK0
lower case: akiafakefakefakefake
inside a word: XAKIAFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKE
